tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs chog thar pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba nag 'gros su bkod pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// las kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs kyi mchog /gang de'i bsnyen pa yin go de yi phyir// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag byas 'dir// mar me mdzad lung ma 'khyog gzhan la bgo/ las kyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyang zhing phyi ma mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su legs pa'i dpal thams cad la rtse bar 'dod pa dag gis/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa nod cing byang chub tu sems bskyed/ 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur ba thob par byas te/ dang por bsnyen pa/ bar du dkyil 'khor chen po'i las rim/ tha mar lho sgo'i cho ga gsum las/ dang por bsnyen pa ni/ yo byad thams cad tshang bar bsags/ khrus la sogs pa gtsang sbra byas/ bde ba'i stan la rdo rje skyil mo krung gis 'dug pas/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la// de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jig pa sel ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi// bdag ni 'jigs pas rnam skrag ste// kun tu bzang la bdag nyid 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bdag nyid kyis// bdag gi lus 'di 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan bdag la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i sting po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje che mgon thams cad la// skyabs 'tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byer mdzad pa'i// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyod kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/

dge legs rin chen rdul brtsegs stobs bcu'i dpal// mthong thos dran pas ngan song kun sbyong ba// srid pa'i rkyen gyis nam yang mi 'khrugs pa'i// bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i las kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol// gsang bdag dpa' bo rdo rje 'phags pa lha// zla grags slob pa'i rdo rje nyi ma sbas// smṛ ti dz+nyā na dpal ldan a ti shar// mi phyed gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i las kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol// lo chen rin bzang shes rab bla ma dang*// bshes gnyen bka' lung bon sgom btsang pa rgya// seng ge'i mtshan dgu bsam rgyal kha che la// dad pas thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i las kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol// rigs gsum rje dang rgyal ba'i dbang yab sras// ngag gi dbang phyug kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar// ngag dbang bzang dang dpag bsam dbang po'i zhabs// dngos po kun gyis btud de phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i las kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol// yongs 'dzin dam pa chos kyi dbang phyug dang*// dge legs bzhad pa 'jam mgon dbyes pa'i dbang*// 'jam dpal dpa' bo chos kyi snang ba la// dad gsum dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i las kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol// ye shes grub pa'i mi pham chos kyi rgyal// chos kyi nyin byed shes bya kun mkhyen zhabs// gdams pa'i gter mdzod drin can rje bla mar// sgo gsum rab tu btud de phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i las kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol// gzhan yang skyabs gsum kun dang dbyer med pa'i// ye shes lnga rdzogs mi bskyod thugs rje'i gter// bdag gis rtse gcig gus pas skyabs gsol na// mar gyur 'gro rnams mngon dga'i zhing drangs te// byang chub mchog gi sa la 'god mdzad gsol// rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla la hūm̐/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma steng du bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de la/ chos nyid mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rjes gtan du mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// 'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag 'tshal/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ thog mtha' 'dra/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe/ naiwid+ya/ shap+ta sa mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ ces lan gsum gyis bdun rnam dag gi sgo nas skyabs sems blangs/ badz+ra muḥtshogs zhing rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig oṃ swa bhā wa shu d+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag med pa gnyis kyi rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid du gyur/ byang chub sems kyi lha'o// de'i mdangs hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/

phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba zlum po la rdo rje mda'i dra bas brgyan pa/ bar mtshams med pa/ cis kyang mi tshugs pa/ cis kyang mi shigs pa/ cis kyang mi 'jigs pa'i rdo rje'i mkhar me'i phung po 'bar ba nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i nang du bh+rūṃ las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzhal yas khang rdo rje rin po che'i rgyal po dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba las grub pa gru bzhi pa rmang gi phyir 'dod pa'i lha mo gnas pa'i pad+ma rā ga'i snam bu dang*/ ba gaṃ dzam+bu na dī ha ra nag po'i steng gi gser gdung las mu tig dkar dmar gyi dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ rgya phubs kyi lcam sna las thur du in+d+ra ni la'i shar bu dang*/ rtsig pa'i thad dang mnyam pa'i steng du karke ta'i bod skad du ke ke ru zhes pa 'di la rgya skad du/ karketanaṃ/ zhes pa 'dug pas dpyad zhus dag pas mda' yab pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang gdugs ba dan rnam pa mang pos mdzes pa/ thog 'phar ma sum brtsegs kyi dbus 'phyur bu rin po che'i tog gis brgyan cing*/ sgo bzhi'i sgo khyud twa ra ṇa legs sbyar tshig mdzod du ho ra ṇa zhes pa 'dug bzhis spras pa'i rtser gdugs kyis phub pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa pad+ma la gnas pa'i ri dwags zung mig mi 'dzum par lta ba/ 'bar ba/ bkra ba/ lta na sdug pa/ rnam par phye ba/ phyi nas bltas na nang gsal zhing nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba rgya khyon blos mi 'khyud pa'i nang du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing ka de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi las kyi sgrib pa rgyun bcad sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byas/ nus pa bsdus/ yi ge'i lha'o// oṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya dzaḥ bigh+nān+ta kṛt hūm̐ phaṭ/ thal sbyar mdzub mo gnyis phyir bkyed gung mo cung zad gug byas pa'i dam rgya bcas dam tshig 'di brjod do//

ta thā ga tod bha wā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sgra dang phyag rgya'i lha'o// zla ba sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog bai ḍūr+ya mthon mthing lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po blta bas chog mi shes par mdzes pa/ cod pan la sogs pa lha'i rgyan dang na bza' thams cad kyis spras pa/ glang po che'i khri gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ge sar bsil zer can gyis mnan cing zla bas rgyab brten byas pa'i steng du rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gzugs kyi lha'o// sor mo bsnol ba'i 'khor lo'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mtheb mdzub gnyis phyir cung zad bkyed pa pad+ma'i phyag rgya mgrin par bzhag mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥmatshan pa/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i srin lag gnyis nang du bcug pa bsnol ba'i rtse mo mdzub mo'i drung du cung zad mngon par byas gung mo'i tshigs phyi rol nas mdzub mo gnyis bkug pas mnan mthe bong mthe'u chung so sor gshibs pa'i rtse gung mo la btud pa rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o// des snying kar gtugs/ rang gi snying 'od kyi gur khyim du gyur pa'i dbus su pad zlar hūm̐ las rdo rje zhes byin gyis brlab/ snying ka'i pad zla'i rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa/ phyogs bzhir rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can rin chen tog ser po mchog sbyin dang mnyam bzhag 'od dpag med dmar po ting nge 'dzin/ rnga sgra ljang khu skyabs sbyin dang mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ gtso bo bzhin du rgyan gyis brgyan nas bzhugs pa/ de'i gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba la rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa hūm̐ las 'od zer gyi rtse mo la bkra shis rtags brgyad yod pa rim bzhin pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la bkod/

oṃ maṅga la shrī dza da ma dza swā hā/ shar du pad+ma can dkar mo g.yas dpal be'u/ sngags thog mtha' 'dra/ tsakra/ mer 'jigs byed ma dkar mo g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ lhor 'od can ma sngon mo g.yas pad+ma/ dh+wa dza/ bden bral du rnam par rgyal ma sngo skya g.yas rgyal mtshan/ ts+tsha traṃ/ nub tu mdangs ldan ma dmar skya g.yas mu tig gi gdugs/ ka la sha rlung du kar sham ma dmar skya g.yas bum pa bzang po/ shaṅkha/ byang du sgrib med la ljang khu g.yas g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung*/ oṃ maṅga la mat+s+ya swā hā/ dbang ldan du yid gzhung ma ljang khu g.yas gser nya pho mo/ badz+ra aṅgu sha dzaḥ shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu/ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrog badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ byang sgor dril bu ma ljang khu g.yas dril bu/ thams cad kyang g.yon dku la brten pa/ lha'i na chung yid 'phrog pa'i gzugs/ rgyan dang gos mdzes pa thams cad kyis klubs te sems dpa'i skyil krung gis zla bas rgyab rten dang gdan byas pa la bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis 'og min gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya dzaḥbigh+nān+ta kṛt hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ thal sbyar mdzub mo gnyis phyir bkyed gung mo cung zad gug byas pa'i dam rgya bcas dam tshig gi sngags 'di brjod do// ta thā ga tod bha wā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ thal mo lhan cig dam du sbyar te pad+ma'i tshul du bgyis pa la mdzub mo nor bur bgyis te yid tsam bkug pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i phyag rgya spyi bo/

dpral ba/ rna ltag g.yas/ ltag pa/ rna ltag g.yon rnams su bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bhiṣiñcha hrīḥ.oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca aḥ de la mchod pa re re'ang nam mkha' khyab par mos pas/ oṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pariwār ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ lha mo zla ba ltar dkar gzugs// mtshar sdug lang tshos snyems pa'i gar// me tog 'phreng bas sgrib zol gyis// mtho ris mdun sa bzhin du mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lha mo nam mkha' ltar mthing gzugs// dri zhim ngad pa 'thul ba'i gar// bdug spos 'phreng bas sgrib zol gyis// mtho ris= dhū pe= lha mo mtshams sprin ltar dmar gzugs// nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od 'phro'i gar// mar me'i 'phreng bas= mtho ri= ā lo ke lha mo margata ltar ljang gzugs// reg pas sim byed byug pa'i gar// dri chab 'phreng bas= mtho ris mdun sa= gan+dhe= lha mo gser ltar ser ba'i gzugs// ma mchu'i ro brgya dngar ba'i gar// zhal zas 'phreng bas= mtho ris= nai wi d+ya/ lha mo bai ḍūr+ya ltar sngo gzugs// snyan 'gyur glu sgra sgrog pa'i gar// rol mo'i 'phreng= mtho ris= shap+ta= bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje dbyings khyod phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che// rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston mdzad rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal// rin chen rgyal po shin tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// rdo rje'i sku khyod phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// sa dang pha rol phyin pa brnyes// rdo rje gsung khyod phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs shing*// dag pa'i ngo bo nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstod//

yang na/ hūm̐/ mgon po nam mkha' mtshan dpes rab mdzes pa// sa gnon mnyam bzhag phyag rgya rdo rje 'dzin// las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rgyun gcod pa'i// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// pad can dung ltar rab dkar zla bzhin ma// dpal gyi be'u thogs nas snyems pa yis// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis lha mo de la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs byed kun+da'i 'od ldan lus phra ma// gser gyi 'khor lo 'chang ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis// 'phags= bkra shis= 'od can mthon mthing bcu drug lang tsho ma// rin chen 'dab brgya bzung nas rol rtsed kyis// 'phags= bkra shis= rnam rgyal sngo skya 'dod pa'i dbyangs mkhan ma// rgyal mtshan bsgreng zhing ga ma kas bcings glus// 'phags= bkra shis= mdangs ldan li khri'i rdul 'chang mig yangs ma// mu tig gdugs dkar bskor zhing zur mig mdas// 'phags= bkra shis= dkar sham mtshams sprin mdog can gzugs mdzes ma// gter gyi bum pas lag brel rtsed 'jo yis// 'phags= bkra shis= dri med margata mdangs ldan dpal ldan ma// g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung bsnams 'jo sgeg gis// 'phags= bkra shis= yid gzhungs rma bya'i mgrin 'dra dga' bskyed ma// gser gyi nya 'dzin 'gying gzugs glog 'dra bas// 'phags= bkra shis= zhi ba'i lha mo rab dkar lang tsho'i dpal// sgeg mo'i dpyid gyur 'gro la rjes chags pas// byams pa tshad med lcags kyu'i phyag mtshan gyis// ma lus 'gugs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyas pa'i lha mo gser mdog= sgeg mo'i dpyid gyur= snying rje tshad med zhags pa'i= ma lus 'ching bar mdzad la= dbang gi lha mo dmar skya= sgeg mo'i= dga' ba tshad med lcags sgrog= ma lus bsdom par mdzad la= drag po'i lha mo ljang kha= sgeg mo'i= btang snyoms tshad med dril bu'i= ma lus mnyed par mdzad la=

thams cad rtse gcig tu bsgom pa mtshan ma'i lha'o// bzlas pa ni/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol// yan lag bzhi dang dmigs pa gsum// rang gi don gyi bsnyen pa yin// grangs dang dus dang mtshan ma'o// dngos grub bsgrub pa'i bzlas pa ni// ngag dang shub bu rdo rje'i bzlas// yid kyi bzlas pa bcas pa bzhi// me dang sgra dang sgra mtha' gsum// brjod pa med pa'i bsam gtan te// thun gsum dag tu bzlas par bya// namo rat+na trayāya/ oṃ kaṃkani kaṃkani/ rotsani rotsani/ troṭani troṭani/ trāsani trāsani/ pratihan pratihan/ sarba karma paraṃparāṇi me sarba sat+t+wānāñca swā hā// las kyi sgrib pa thams cad cad rgyun gcod pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags so// oṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya dzaḥ bigh+nān ྄ta kṛta ྄hūm̐ phaṭ/ snying po'o// 'khor rnams kyi sngags/ oṃ maṅga la shrī dza da ma dza swā hā/ tsakra= pad+ma= dh+wa dza= ts+tsha traṃ= ka la sha= shaṅkha= oṃ maṅga la mat+s+ya swā hā/ badz+ra aṅgu sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ ༈ de nas mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa bgegs bskrad/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ ras bris sam tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ byang chub sems kyi lha'o// de'i mdangs hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba zlum po la rdo rje mda'i dra bas brgyan pa/ bar mtshams med pa/ cis kyang mi tshugs pa/ cis kyang mi shigs pa/ cis kyang mi 'jigs pa'i rdo rje'i mkhar me'i phung po 'bar ba nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i nang du bh+rūṃ las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzhal yas khang rdo rje rin po che'i rgyal po dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba las grub pa gru bzhi pa rmang gi phyir 'dod pa'i lha mo gnas pa'i pad+ma rā ga'i snam bu dang*/

glang po che'i khri gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ge sar bsil zer can gyis mnan cing zla bas rgyab brten byas pa'i steng du rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gzugs kyi lha'o// sor mo bsnol ba'i 'khor lo'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mtheb mdzub gnyis phyir cung zad bkyed pa pad+ma'i phyag rgya mgrin par bzhag mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥmatshan pa/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i srin lag gnyis nang du bcug pa bsnol ba'i rtse mo mdzub mo'i drung du cung zad mngon par byas gung mo'i tshigs phyi rol nas mdzub mo gnyis bkug pas mnan mthe bong mthe'u chung so sor gshibs pa'i rtse gung mo la btud pa rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o// des snying kar gtugs/ thugs 'od kyi gur khyim du gyur pa'i dbus su pad zlar hūm̐ las rdo rje zhes byin gyis brlab/ thugs ka'i pad zla'i rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa/ phyogs bzhir rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can rin chen tog ser po mchog sbyin dang mnyam bzhag 'od dpag med dmar po ting nge 'dzin/ rnga sgra ljang khu skyabs sbyin dang mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ gtso bo bzhin du rgyan gyis brgyan nas bzhugs pa/ de'i gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba la rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa hūm̐ las 'od zer gyi rtse mo la bkra shis rtags brgyad yod pa rim bzhin pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la bkod/ oṃ maṅga la shrī dza da ma dza swā hā/ shar du pad+ma can dkar mo g.yas dpal be'u/ sngags thog mtha' 'dra/ tsakra/ mer 'jigs byed ma dkar mo g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ lhor 'od can ma sngon mo g.yas pad+ma/ dh+wa dza/ bden bral du rnam par rgyal ma sngo skya g.yas rgyal mtshan/ ts+tsha traṃ/ nub tu mdangs ldan ma dmar skya g.yas mu tig gi gdugs/

ka la sha rlung du kar sham ma dmar skya g.yas bum pa bzang po/ shaṅkha/ byang du sgrib med la ljang khu g.yas g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung*/ oṃ maṅga la mat+s+ya swā hā/ dbang ldan du yid gzhung ma ljang khu g.yas gser nya pho mo/ badz+ra aṅgu sha dzaḥ shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu/ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrog badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ byang sgor dril bu ma ljang khu g.yas dril bu/ thams cad kyang g.yon dku la brten pa/ lha'i na chung yid 'phrog pa'i gzugs/ rgyan dang gos mdzes pa thams cad kyis klubs te sems dpa'i skyil krung gis zla bas rgyab rten dang gdan byas pa la bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis 'og min gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya dzaḥbigh+nān+ta kṛt hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ thal sbyar mdzub mo gnyis phyir bkyed gung mo cung zad gug byas pa'i dam rgya bcas dam tshig gi sngags 'di brjod do// ta thā ga tod bha wā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ thal mo lhan cig dam du sbyar te pad+ma'i tshul du bgyis pa la mdzub mo nor bur bgyis te yid tsam bkug pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i phyag rgya spyi bo/ dpral ba/ rna ltag g.yas/ ltag pa/ rna ltag g.yon rnams su bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bhiṣiñcha hrīḥ.oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca aḥ de la mchod pa re re'ang nam mkha' khyab par mos pas/

bla bre gzhal med khang dang gdugs rgyal mtshan// ba dan phye phur lda ldi mchod pa'i sprin// kun tu snang bas nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i// lha rdzas mchod yon bzang pos mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bla bre gzhal med khang dang gdugs rgyal mtshan// ba dan phye phur lda ldi mchod pa'i sprin// kun tu snang bas nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i// lha rdzas me tog bzang pos mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bla bre gzhal med khang dang gdugs rgyal mtshan// ba dan phye phur lda ldi mchod pa'i sprin// kun tu snang bas nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i// lha rdzas bdug spos bzang pos mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhū pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bla bre gzhal med khang dang gdugs rgyal mtshan// ba dan phye phur lda ldi mchod pa'i sprin// kun tu snang bas nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i// lha rdzas snang gsal bzang pos mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bla bre gzhal med khang dang gdugs rgyal mtshan// ba dan phye phur lda ldi mchod pa'i sprin// kun tu snang bas nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i// lha rdzas dri chab bzang pos mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghan+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bla bre gzhal med khang dang gdugs rgyal mtshan// ba dan phye phur lda ldi mchod pa'i sprin// kun tu snang bas nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i// lha rdzas zhal zas bzang pos mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra naiwī d+ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bla bre gzhal med khang dang gdugs rgyal mtshan// ba dan phye phur lda ldi mchod pa'i sprin// kun tu snang bas nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i// lha rdzas rol mo bzang pos mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra shap+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yang na/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa kun// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje'i mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

me tog puṣ+pe/ bdug spos/ dhū pe/ mar me/ ā lo ke dri chab/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas/ nai wi d+ya/ rol mo/ shap+ta/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ mgon po nam mkha' mtshan dpes rab mdzes pa// sa gnon mnyam bzhag phyag rgya rdo rje 'dzin// las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rgyun gcod pa'i// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// pad can dung ltar rab dkar zla bzhin ma// dpal gyi be'u thogs nas snyems pa yis// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis lha mo de la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs byed kun+da'i 'od ldan lus phra ma// gser gyi 'khor lo 'chang ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis// 'phags= bkra shis= 'od can mthon mthing bcu drug lang tsho ma// rin chen 'dab brgya bzung nas rol rtsed kyis// 'phags= bkra shis= rnam rgyal sngo skya 'dod pa'i dbyangs mkhan ma// rgyal mtshan bsgreng zhing ga ma kas bcings glus// 'phags= bkra shis= mdangs ldan li khri'i rdul 'chang mig yangs ma// mu tig gdugs dkar bskor zhing zur mig mdas// 'phags= bkra shis= dkar sham mtshams sprin mdog can gzugs mdzes ma// gter gyi bum pas lag brel rtsed 'jo yis// 'phags= bkra shis= dri med margata mdangs ldan dpal ldan ma// g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung bsnams 'jo sgeg gis// 'phags= bkra shis= yid gzhungs rma bya'i mgrin 'dra dga' bskyed ma// gser gyi nya 'dzin 'gying gzugs glog 'dra bas// 'phags= bkra shis= zhi ba'i lha mo rab dkar lang tsho'i dpal// sgeg mo'i dpyid gyur 'gro la rjes chags pas// byams pa tshad med lcags kyu'i phyag mtshan gyis// ma lus 'gugs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyas pa'i lha mo gser mdog= sgeg mo'i dpyid gyur= snying rje tshad med zhags pa'i= ma lus 'ching bar mdzad la= dbang gi lha mo dmar skya= sgeg mo'i= dga' ba tshad med lcags sgrog= ma lus bsdom par mdzad la= drag po'i lha mo ljang kha= sgeg mo'i=

btang snyoms tshad med dril bu'i= ma lus mnyed par mdzad la= ces bstod/ 'phro 'dus mdun bskyed bskul ba'i bzlas pa bya ba ni/ namo rat+na trayāya/ oṃ kaṃkani kaṃkani/ rotsani rotsani/ troṭani troṭani/ trāsani trāsani/ pratihan pratihan/ sarba karma paraṃparāṇi me sarba sat+t+wānāñca swā hā/ las kyi sgrib pa thams cad cad rgyun gcod pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags so// oṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya dzaḥ bigh+nān ྄ta kṛta ྄hūm̐ phaṭ/ snying po'o// 'khor rnams kyi sngags/ oṃ maṅga la shrī dza da ma dza swā hā/ tsakra= pad+ma= dh+wa dza= ts+tsha traṃ= ka la sha= shaṅkha= oṃ maṅga la mat+s+ya swā hā/ badz+ra aṅgu sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ ༈ de nas bum bskyed ni/ bum pa swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las phyi bum pa nang bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ de'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po/ de'i steng du a las zla ba la/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya dzaḥbigh+nān+ta kṛt hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ thal sbyar mdzub mo gnyis phyir bkyed gung mo cung zad gug byas pa'i dam rgya bcas dam tshig gi sngags 'di brjod do// ta thā ga tod bha wā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ las thams cad par rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kha 'gram du rdo rje mche ba 'dzin pa'o// mchod pa ni/ chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin du// mchod yon rgyun yang mi chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ 'gre'o// me tog pad+ma'i tshal bzhin du// me tog rgyun yang mi chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

tsan dan sdong po'i dri bzhin du// bdug spos rgyun yang mi chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i 'dug spos 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ nyi zla nor bu'i 'od bzhin du// snang gsal rgyun yang mi chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i snang gsal 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ ho len ta yi rgyun bzhin du// dri chab rgyun yang mi chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i dri chab 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghan+dhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ so rtsi ka yi ro bzhin du// ro mchog rgyun yang mi chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i zhal zas 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta naiwī d+ya pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ pi waṃ gling bu'i sgra bzhin du// sgra snyan rgyun yang mi chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i sil snyan 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/
