spyon zhig /'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*// dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yul kun gnas dang*// shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*// grong khyer kun na gang dag gnas pa dang*// chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang*// rin chen gling na lhag par gangs gnas dang*// rdzing dang mtsho dang lu ma lteng ka dang*// khron pa dang ni ngam grog chu mig dang*// grong dang phyug lhas dang ni nags tshal dang*// khang stong dang ni lha yi khang pa dang*// gang dag gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas// bsod nams khyim dang glang po'i khang rnams dang*// gang dag rgyal po'i dkor khang gnas pa dang*// srang dang khyams dang grong gi 'dun sa dang*// gang dag shing gcig drung dang lam chen gnas// dur khrod dang ni nags tshal cher gnas dang*// seng ge glang chen dred kyi gnas rnams dang*// gang dag 'jigs rung dgon pa cher gnas dang*// chu gling mchog dag tu ni gnas byas dang*// gang dag 'brog dgon dur khrod dag na gnas// dga' zhing mgu nas dri ma me tog 'phreng*// spos dang me tog mar me gus phul ba// 'di dag bsnams te so sor bzhes nas kyang*// las 'di dag gi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod//

gdon la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir de ltar byas te/ de nas cha gcig la phyogs skyong rnams mchod par bya ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams brjod par bya'o// shar phyogs rdo rje can te lha tshogs bcas// gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol// me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*// dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*// steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*// lha rnams ma lus sa yi klu dag dang*// ri yi lha dang gsang ba'i tshogs 'dus la// so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di bzhes la// rang rang gi ni phyogs su bzhugs nas kyang*// rang gi bu smad grogs dang g.yog 'khor bcas// dpung dang sde bcas mnyes nas bzhes su gsol// spos dang me tog gtor ma zhal zas ni// 'di dag bzhes shing so sor bsnams nas kyang*// bya ba 'di ni 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// 'di ni bgegs nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i don du 'am/ dgos pa gzhan 'dod pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis bsgrub par bya'o// gtor ma 'di la sngags rnams ni// kun tu 'byung ba med mod kyi// 'on kyang tshigs bcad tsam gyis ni// 'di ni gdon sogs tshim par 'gyur// dka' thub dang ni bden pa rnams// lhag pa yang dag thob 'gyur ba// bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' lung ni// 'di ltar sngags dang mtshungs par 'dod// bslu ba med pa'i tshig gang yin// de ni gsang sngags nyid du 'dod// mu stegs kyis ni bgrangs pa'i sngags// de nyid phyir ni tshad ma min// de bas dngos grub thob rnams kyi// tshig gang de sngags nyid yin te// spyod lam bzhi po 'di dag ni// phyag rgya nyid du bshad pa yin// de bas gtor ma'i las 'di la// tshig bshad gsang sngags nyid du 'grub// de bas 'di ni swā hā sogs// spel ba'i sngags ni dgos pa med// de ni gdon dang phyogs skyong gi gtor ma'i cho ga'o// cha gcig bgegs la byin te/

hūm̐/ gang dag mtshan mo rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa// de dang de la gtor ma ni// bza' ba sha chang la phug dang*// 'bras chan 'bras bu mang por bcas// mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid// de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis// zhes bya bas bsngo bar bya'o// mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo sngags kyis mchod/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu rab bkram nas// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ me tog phal cher me tog bla bre dang*// me tog bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// me tog sna tshogs kun tu rab bkram nas// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bdug spos phal cher bdug spos bla bre dang*// bdug spos bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// bdug spos sna tshogs kun tu rab bkram nas// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhū pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ snang gsal phal cher snang gsal bla bre dang*/ snang gsal bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// snang gsal sna tshogs kun tu rab bkram nas// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra a lo ke hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dri chab phal cher dri chab bla bre dang*// dri chab bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// dri chab sna tshogs kun tu rab bkram nas// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhal zas phal cher zhal zas bla bre dang*// zhal zas bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// zhal zas sna tshogs kun tu rab bkram nas// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra nai wi d+ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

sil snyan phal cher sil snyan bla bre dang*// sil snyan bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// sil snyan sna tshogs kun tu rab bkram nas// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra shap+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bstod pa ni/ chos nyid mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rjes gtan du mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sogs dang*/ bstod pa 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra sat+t+wa samayamanupālaya/ badz+ra sat+t+watwenopatiṣ+ṭha/ dṛḍho me bhab/ sutoṣ+yo me bhab/ supoṣ+yo me bhab/ anurak+to me bhab/ sarba sid+dhim+me prayats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shreyaḥkuru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbhagaban sarba tathāgata badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+rī bhab/ mahā samaya sat+t+wa āḥ yig brgya brjod/ bzod gsol ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs dang*/ bag med brjod bya ma rtogs pa// rgyud las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin// ma lcogs 'khrul ba ci bgyis pa// de yang bzod pa mdzad du gsol// khyed la mchod bstod gsol ba btab pa sogs/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ ras bris yod na/ 'di ni rten dang lhan cig tu sogs dang nas badz+ra ye swā hā/ bdag bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams me long la has btab pa bzhin bsdus nas mi dmigs shing bum bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams bum pa'i chu deng bar gyur/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /mi 'khrugs mgon po 'grub gyur nas sogs dang*/ bdag gis sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan shes rab dge ba bsgrub pa rnams// 'gro ba kun gyi thun mong nyid gyur des// thams cad mngon dga'i zhing du skye bar shog/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du 'dren pa'i smon lam yid kyi shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'tsho zhing gzhes pa mi 'khrugs pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la dus dang rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na de bzhin gshegs pa dang sangs rgyas dang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grangs su 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spos kyi glang po che dang ba glang spos kyi glang po che la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa de dag thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// da ltar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das sras dang slob ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nyan thos dge 'dun chen pos kun nas bskor// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis mdun du bdar// bgrang yas lha mi'i dbus na chos ston pa'i// sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi smon lam dag pa'i gzi brjid dang*// dri med mtshan dang sngon gyi spyod pa'i mtha'// yongs su bsgrags pa tsam gyis srid pa'i rmongs// ma lus 'phrog pa de la= sems kyi glang po ye shes lcags kyus btul// sgrib gnyis bud shing nyer zhi'i me la bsregs// bdud kyi las rnams byams pa'i mtshon gyis gtubs// 'dab brgya ltar rgyas de la= dam pa'i grib bsil grags snyan me tog dkar// ma smad snying stobs phun tshogs 'bras bus dud// bsod nams skyed mos tshal gyi dpal gcig pu// sangs rgyas ljon pa'i mchog la= 'chi med grub pa'i zur phud mkha' la rgyu// yon tan mi zad glog 'gyu'i dpal yon can// stobs bcu ldan pa'i zhabs rdul sprin phreng gis// srid pa'i tsha gdung skyob der=

sum cu gnyis mtshan dpe byad brgya phrag bcus// rab mdzes lta bas mi ngom bdud rtsi'i gzugs// mkha' lding gnas kyi rin chen mchod sdong ni// baiḍūr mthon mthing dang 'drar= sku tshe bstan pa bskal chen 'bum phrag bcu// zhing gi khyon dang nyan thos byang sems kyi// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' mi mngon pa'i// 'dren pa mnyam med thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// skye bo nyon mongs dug gis mgo rmongs nas// 'gro drug bar ma do ru 'khyams pa rnams// de ring nyid du phan mdzad phyag rkyongs la// mngon dga'i zhing du drongs shig mi 'khrugs pa// bdag gis sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan shes rab dge ba bsgrubs pa rnams// 'gro ba kun gyi thun mong nyid gyur des// thams cad mngon dga'i zhing du skye bar shog /gang drung mgon des sangs rgyas byang chub shing*// rin chen bdun grub dpag tshad 'bum ldan pa// lhun po dbang po'i tshon gyis mdzes 'dra ba'i// mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du skye bar shog /pha rol phyin dang mngon shes dbang po stobs// byang chub lam gyi yan lag brjod pa'i sgra// snyan par sgrogs pa'i shing dbang de blta phyir// mngon par dga' ba'i= gseg ma ri dang mu stegs can gyi gnas// snyigs ma lnga dang yid mi 'ong kun dang*// ngan song gsum dang log par ltung med pa// mngon par dga' ba'i= sa gzhi thams cad mnyam pa gser mdangs can// reg na bde ba ka tsa lin+dha bzhin// mnan na nem 'gyur btegs na 'phar byed pa// mngon par dga' ba'i= man+dā ra sogs me tog tshogs kyis brgyan// lha gnas nor bu'i tshogs ni phyogs bcur bkram// gser gyi pad+mo'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i gzhi// mngon par dga' ba'i= me tog 'bras bus rtag par dud gyur pa'i// dri med rin chen ljon pa'i grib bsil dang*// dpag bsam 'khri zhing gzhon nu'i lding khang can// mngon par dga' ba'i=

gser gyi ta la'i ljon shing phreng ba rnams// rlung gis bskyod pas snyan dang 'jebs pa dang*// yid 'ong chags par 'gyur ba'i sgra dbyangs can// mngon par dga' ba'i= rnam lnga'i mdangs gsal dri zhim gos dang rgyan// yid 'ong dpag bsam shing las da lta 'khrungs// bsam pas lha yi zas mchog mdun 'byung ba// mngon par dga' ba'i= rin chen sna bdun gzhal med khang brtsegs nang*// rin chen bdun khri 'bol ba'i stan can rnams// 'chi med grong khyer sa la bkod 'dra ba'i// mngon par dga' ba'i= 'byung 'brang mi snang 'dod pa ltar byed pa'i// gser gyi bye ma brdal ba'i rdzing bu'i 'gram// lha shing mya ngan med pa'i phreng bas mdzes// mngon par dga' ba'i= ha cang dro min grang min 'jam dang ldan// dri zhim spos kyi bya ba byed pa'i rlung*// 'dod na ldang zhing mi 'dod zhi 'gyur ba'i// mngon par dga' ba'i= 'gas kyang lha dang mi phyed skyes pa dang*// bud med skyon bral dbyangs can bu mo yi// mtshar sdug yon tan kun 'dzin sha stag pa// mngon par dga' ba'i= chags na blta ba'i rtse dgas 'dod bral zhing*// zhag bdun mngal du gnas dang 'dzin byed ma// bsam gtan gnyis par snyoms zhugs bde myong 'dra'i// mngon par dga' ba'i= zhabs bkod gser gyi pad+mo rtag bskrun pa'i// mi 'khrugs chos rgyal mchod phyir lha dang mi'i// ngang pa rtag par 'du ba pad+ma'i mtsho// mngon par dga' ba'i= nyi zla snang byed thams cad zil mnan nas// sangs rgyas 'od kyis rtag par stong gsum kun// gur gum gzhon nu'i mdzes pa ston byed pa// mngon par dga' ba'i= sa gzhi lha yi phun tshogs yongs kyis bstar// mkha' nas mtho ris grong gis brgyan pa'i bar// gser dngul bai ḍūr them skas sbrel ba can// mngon par dga' ba'i= mgon de'i chos kyi mdun sar lan re res// sems can dpag med dgra bcom nyid thob cing*// de dag cho 'phrul gsum gyis 'da' bgyid pa// mngon par dga' ba'i=

de ltar thogs pa'ang stan gcig chos dang pos// rgyun zhugs gnyis pas phyir 'ong gsum pa yis// phyir mi 'ong dang bzhi par dgra bcom pa// mngon par dga' ba'i= so so rig dang rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi// mngon shes drug ldan thos pa kun 'dzin cing*// rnam thar brgyad la bsam gtan pas gtams pa// mngon par dga' ba'i= gang du skyes pas bde gshegs la bsten cing*// bdud kyis mi brdzi nyan rang sar mi ltung*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub lung bstan thob 'gyur pa// mngon par dga' ba'i= mi 'khrugs mgon de'i dam chos kun 'dzin cing*// 'chang dang klog cing kun chub ston byed pa// tshe 'phos nas kyang brjed par mi 'gyur ba// mngon par dga' ba'i= phyogs bcu'i zhing kun phyin nas rgyal rnams kyi// dam pa'i chos bzung slar yang ldog byed pa// mkhas pa rgya mtsho'i ded dpon kho na'i gling*// mngon par dga' ba'i= byang chub dam par sangs rgyas ma gyur bar// sangs rgyas zhing nas sangs rgyas zhing 'gro zhing*// thub pa'i khyu mchog thams cad mnyes bgyid pa// mngon par dga' ba'i= khyim du gnas sam rab tu byung ba'i sras// gal te chos kyi mdun sar mi snang na'ang*// sangs rgyas mthu yis thos nas 'dzin byed pa// mngon par dga' ba'i= 'chi 'pho na yang skye 'gyur zhing gang dang*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod// mngon sum snang ba nyid du mi 'bral ba// mngon par dga' ba'i= tshad med sprul pas mtha' klas sems can gyi// nyes pa'i dug sdong rtsad nas 'byin mdzad pa'i// phyir mi ldog pa'i sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i gnas// mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du skye bar shog /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du skyes nas kyang*// mi 'khrugs pa yi sngon gyi smon lam dang*// byang chub spyod pa'i rjes su slob byed cing*// byang chub dam par lung bstan thob par shog /mi 'khrugs pa yi spyod la gnas nas kyang*// sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mnyes byed cing*// dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rdzogs byas nas// mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob gyur cig

/dad pas yid brlan lag gnyis thal sbyar nas// smon lam mchog 'di lan mang 'don bgyid na// shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i ston pa des// thugs rje'i phyag gis myur du 'dzin par 'gyur// 'di nas nying mtshams sbyar ma thag /dag pa'i zhing mchog mngon dga' ru// pad+mo'i snying po'i ze'u 'bru la// brdzus te skye ba len par shog /pad+mo 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos par// srid pa'i pad+mo las grol zhing*// mngon par dga' bar skye bar shog /de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang*// 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang*// khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba// de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog/

de ltar sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod pa'i smon lam 'di ni/ nang gi rnal 'byor gyi stobs rgyas pas bcos ma'i 'khri ba kun zhig pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas/ mang du thos pa'i dge slong pad+ma dkar pos 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chos kyi rnam grangs stong phrag brgya pa nas phyung ste sbyar ba'o// ces mngon par dga' ba'i smon lam ji lta ba btab nas spyod lam la 'jug go /bsnyen pa'i yi ge'o// // dpal 'brug pa rin po che'i bstan pa rgya cher rgyas par smon pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i dri bsung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru rat+na tra ya yā/ chos nyid gdod nas nyer zhi spros dang bral// chos can rten cing 'brel 'byung bslu ba med// tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs yang dag bde bar gshegs// 'gog dang zhi ba lam bden dam pa'i chos// rig grol tshogs mchog 'phags pa dge la 'dun// rigs kun khyab bdag rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// dngos grub mchog ster yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// bar chad kun sel mkha' 'gro dam can dang*// dkar phyogs skyong ba kun gyi bden pa'i mthus// thub bstan yang snying nges gsang dri ma med// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /tshul khrims dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtsa ba brtan// ting nge 'dzin gyis yal 'dab rab rgyas shing*// shes rab sor rtogs 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa rgyas= legs bshad bye ba'i chos rnams ma 'dres 'chad// phas rgol mthar byed rtsod ngag seṅge'i sgra// tshig don rgyan 'grel rtsom pa'i mgrin rnga 'khrol// dpal ldan 'brug= lung rtogs rigs pa'i gzhung lugs mang du thos// brtags dpyad mkhar rgyu bsam pa'i sprin phung gtibs// nang du yang dag 'jog ste sgom mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i= kun 'byung bag chags 'dul byed bden pa bzhi// zab dang rgya che mdo sde'i chu klung 'bum// chos mngon ke ta ka yis sgrung byas pa'i// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i=

so so thar pa'i sa gzhi gtsang ma ru// byang chub sems kyi myu gu mtshar du dngar// yid skyob lam gyi sa bon cher smin pa'i// dpal ldan= gnas dang nye ba'i gnas mchog la sogs par// kun tu bzang po rig pa brtul bzhugs dang*// phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod pa mthar phyin pa'i// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i= sku yi ngo mtshar 'chi med ljon pa bzhin// rdo rje'i gsung gsang tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar 'jebs// sgrib bral thugs kyi pha mtha' mkha' ji ltar// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i= mkhyen pa'i ye shes lha lam yangs pa la// brtse ba'i thugs rje'i chu 'dzin rnam par g.yo// skyob pa nus mthu'i char gyis 'gro kun tshim// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i= mkhas pa'i ngang pas klog pa'i rdza rnga brdung*// grub pa'i seṅge spong ba'i gangs rir 'gying*// bya ba'i shing rtas bstan pa'i khur chen 'degs// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i= 'khrul dang grol ba gnyis su med gzigs nas// tshe gcig rdo rje'i go 'phang mchog brnyes pas// 'og min gnas mchog dog por 'gengs mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i= spang dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyang*// dmigs med snying rjes 'gro la rjes chags pas// nam mkha' ji srid 'bad med don mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i= yang dag lam gyi dngos grub mchog brnyes te// gangs ri'i khrod du theg mchog chos sgra sgrogs// sgrub brgyud snying po'i ring lugs gsal mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ ༈ kun mkhyen rje'i gsung*/ legs bshad grwa 'dir blo gsal rgya mtsho'i tshogs// gnyis 'thung che la bung ba ltar 'dus nas// rgyal ba'i gzhung lugs kun la mkhas sbyangs pas// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i= bde gshegs ston pa'i bstan pa mchog gi mtsho// snyan pa'i 'brug sgra sgrogs pa'i sprin phreng gi /bshad sgrub char gyis nyin bzhin rnam spel bas// yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad 'gengs gyur cig

/sdom gsum nyin mo'i 'od dang rtag 'grogs shing*// thos bsam sgom pa'i dri bzang 'dzin pa'i dpyid// bstan 'dzin pad+mo'i gtso bo ci yang gis// yangs pa'i rgyal khams= rnyed dang bkur bsti'i chu klung rnams 'bab cing*// phan dang bde ba'i rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas// chos 'khor gsar pa gsar pa'i dpal rgya mtshos// yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad 'gengs gyur cig /'dus pa pad+mo'i 'byung gnas 'di nyid du// mkhas grub ngang pa'i ded dpon kun 'dus nas// pad dkar bzhad pa'i dri bsung gis sim pa'i// dam chos mgrin rnga brdung bas rtag 'gengs shog/ ༈ lha mchog gsung*/ 'og min ston pa'i gces phrug mchog gzigs gnyis// rab dkar brgyud pa'i chu mgo gong ma gsum// dbyar mtshor spel mdzad khams ston yab sras kyi// thugs bskyed bstan pa dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /lta bas gnam 'phang spyod pa gling chen ras// sgom pa'i rgyal sa zin mdzad gtsang pa rgya// spyod pas rtsal chen rdzogs pa lo rgod gnyis// thugs bskyed bstan pa= stod 'brug skar tshogs nam mkha' khyab par brdal// smad 'brug grub thob gaṅgā'i rdul grangs mnyam// bar 'brug bu chen dbyar gyi rtsa ltar rgyas// thugs bskyed bstan pa= gdan sa ya bzhi'i kai lā sha ri'i ngogs// seng chen dgu tshar thugs rje'i g.yu ral rgyas// chos rje khu dbon smon lam rtsal chen rdzogs// thugs bskyed bstan pa= don rgyud kun dga'i skyed tshal yangs pa ru// rgyal kun byin rlabs nyi 'od kyis bskyed pa'i// mkhyen gnyis 'dab brgya grol ba'i pad+ma dkar// thugs bskyed bstan pa= snying rje'i gter chen rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen// bstan pa'i 'khor lo yongs su 'dzin pa che// mthu stobs dbang phyug gsang bdag chos kyi mgon// thugs bskyed bstan pa= mtsho skyes bla ma dngos snang mdo khams pa// bka' drin sum ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po mchog

/yab sras grub thob brgyud pa ma lus pa'i// thugs bskyed bstan pa dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// dkar phyogs dge ba'i mthu dang nus pa yis// rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin dpal ldan 'brug pa'i zhabs// sku tshe brtan cing phrin las rgyas gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas de de bzhin tu 'grub par gyur cig /dza ya dza ya su dza ya// // de ltar byang phyogs gangs ri'i khrod kyi bstan pa'i yang snying 'jig rten dbang phyug dpal 'brug pa rin po che'i bstan pa rgya cher rgyas par smon pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i dri bsung zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po kun mkhyen thams cad mkhyen pas rjes su bzung ba'i dka' 'bangs kyi yang tha ngag dbang bstan 'dzin blo gros su 'bod pas/ nyi sgrol byed ces yal ga'i ri dwags margad kyi gos bzang bgo ba'i dus kyi cha shas sa ga zla ba'i sher phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa gza' skar sogs yan lag lnga'i sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i dus/ thun bar gcig la sug las su bstar ba bslu med skyabs rnams byin mthus nges gsang dbyar rnga'i ring lugs nyi 'og kun tu khyab par smon no// ༈ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i las rim bzhugs so// bar du dkyil 'khor chen po'i las rim bya ba la/ sa chog sta gon/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/ dbang bzhi las/ dang po rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor byed pa'i tshe/ sngon du gza' skar dus sbyor shis pa'i dus su sa'i dbus su dri'i thig le byas/ me tog gi tshom bu/ mchod gtor bshams nas/ gtsang sbra bya ba nas bzlas pa'i bar byas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag kyang bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri//

zhes mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgyas rdo rje brdabs pas/ sa'i dbus nas sa'i lha mo brtan ma mdzes sdug mtshungs pa med pa rgyan gyis brgyan te 'khor 'bum phrag dang bcas te lus phyed snang bar 'thon pa la/ pra ti bh+yaḥ.ar+ghaṃ/ push+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ pra ti bh+yaḥ na ma s+sa r+b+ba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga ta s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na ba ling+ta khā hi/ gang yang sa la gnas pa dang*// sa la rgyu ba'i lha mo rnams// mchod dang gtor ma 'di long la// sems can kun dag don du yang*// byams pa'i sems kyis gnang bar mdzod// ces bslang pas sa phyogs 'dir ci dga' bar spyod cig ces gnang ba sbyin te gzhi'i bdag po dang bcas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur// yid ches pa'i sa ma yin na ro lnga bsal/ rin po che lnga la sogs pa bcug ste 'thas par bcags nas stegs bu gru bzhi pa steng me long gi ngos 'dra bar bya'o// der ba byung ngam dri byug pa byug te me tog gsil ma bkram/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags kyis sbyangs/ sku gzugs bzhag pa sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs gyis gzung ba 'o// gnyis pa la/ bgegs bsal ba/ lha/ bum pa/ slob ma sta gon bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sa gzung ba der bdag nyid gtsang sbra nas bzlas pa'i bar byas nas sta gon gyi bgegs nye bar zhi ba'i cho ga byas te/ rang nyid khro bo me ltar 'bar bar yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje gnod sbyin/ ma dang ṭa las mig gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rje/ rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan par gyur pa langs la rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas stangs stabs byas/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag sham can// rig pa'i rgyal po khro rgyal bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol//

zhes khro bo'i tshogs spyan drangs pa la/ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rnam lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas khro bo'i skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la= lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug gsum rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa'i// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la= bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la= gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la= hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// bka' bsgo ba/ hūm̐/ da ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen por bri// bgegs rnams 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// gal te nga yi bka' las 'das pa na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhi// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// de bas myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig /sum+bha ni zhes bgegs bskrad/ de nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas g.yas bskor du lan gsum skor sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab bo// gnyis pa ni/ lha gnas mi 'chol ba'i phyir thig gdab/

lha gnas su dri gru bzhi me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ stegs bu gtsang ma'i khar bum pa zung*/ bum rdzas la sogs pa tshul bzhin du byas pa mchod pas mdun bdar ba bkod/ snying pos bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung*/ khaṃ gis thams cad stong par gyur/ hūm̐ gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang lha bskyed pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin no// spyan drangs pa nas mchod bstod yan byas/ snying ka'i zla ba la gsang sngags dmigs te cung zad bzlas/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas/ gtor ma btang*/ gsum pa ni/ bum pa swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ baṃ las phyi bum pa nang bdud rtsi rgya mtsho/ de'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po/ de'i steng du a las zla ba la/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlas thams cad par rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kha 'gram du rdo rje mche ba 'dzin pa'o// de la mchod bstod bya/ 'phro 'du tshul gyis snying po lha sngags gzungs 'don/ las thams cad par badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ bzlas brjod byas/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang ba gyur/ lha khrus la sogs pa'i dus su nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ slob ma khrus byas/ gos gsar pa gyon/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bla ma bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa zhu snyam du/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum/ tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal mdun du bkod/ a shwa tā sogs pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mo me tog gis bcings pa sbyin/ badz+ra hā sa a zhes pas dor du 'jug go/ dbus su mchog shar zhi ba la sogs pa/ mtshams 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub/ steng 'og mkha' dang sa la spyod pa'i rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro// rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas pa'i srung skud skyes pa'i g.yas dang bud med kyi g.yon du bcings/

badz+ra rāk+ṣa zhes rdo rje rgya gram du dri'i chu dang bcas byin gyis brlab/ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha zhes bzlas pa'i ku sha sngas dang stan du phyin/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// zhes chos bshad/ bzhin bzang dag do nub nyol la rmi lam rtog shig dang*/ sang dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro// de nas sta gon gyi lha la/ bcom ldan mi 'khrugs rgyal po ni// rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa dang*// sems can kun la brtse don du// sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// yo byad ci 'byor gyis bris na// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su// tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol//

zhes snyan gsan phab nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang par bla ma dang slob ma ku sha sngas dang stan la nyal lo// de nas sta gon gyi lha la mchod bstod byas te/ badz+ra driṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ ces nam mkha' la bteg go /gsum pa la/ thig tshon gyi las/ gnas brgyan pa/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dngos so// dang po ni/ thig tshon la yid kyis 'og min gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi thig tshon spyan drangs/ 'bar ba'i blta bas dzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod/ so sor thim/ thig tshon spyi dang mthun par gdab pa dang dgye bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ bla bre yol ba lda ldi la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad kyis mdzes par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ tshogs bsag nas bzlas pa'i bar gyi bdag bskyed byas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsang gtor byas/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya dzaḥ bigh+nan ta krita hūm̐ phaṭ a/ lha mo brgyad dang sgo ma'i sngags kyi mthar ā btags pas lha mtshan la sta gon gyi ye shes phab/ gnyis su med par thim/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ hūm̐ las nas bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin las/ 'phro 'dus mdun bskyed bskul ba'i bzlas pa bya'o// bum pa sta gon bzhin/ cha gsum btang*// ༈ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang gi cho ga bzhugs so// bzhi pa dbang gi cho ga ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis slob ma khrus byas/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs maṇ+ḍal phul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcings/ bdun rnam dag gis skyabs sems phog bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa kye// gtso 'khor thams cad dgongs su gsol// mi shes mun gyis bsgribs pa la// dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ bla mas khrid shar sgo nas zhugs khyams su gnas pa la/ lam chen 'di ni bstan par bya// khyod kyis lam 'di sgrub bar gyis// lam mchog bsgrub la rab tu dga'// nyes pa dag gis ma gos na// 'bras bu myur du 'byin par byed// dam tshig 'das na dmyal bar ltung*// oṃ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥn ra kan hūm̐

zhes mna' chu sbyin/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag nas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya sogs kyi gzungs lan gsum bzlas/ rol mo'i sgra dang sngags kyis btab pa'i yungs kar dang gu gul gyi dud pas bdug des lha'i rigs kyi bsod nams ci 'dra ba de bzhin du 'bab par 'gyur ro// des dkyil 'khor dbang du 'gyur la/ de nas/ rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma'i steng du 'dug la me tog gi 'phreng ba/ hūm̐ pū dza hoḥ zhes pas dkyil 'khor du dor bar bya'o// gtso bo la rdo rje rigs sogs par brda sprad/ gang la phog pa des slar dngos grub kyi don du mgo bor bcings/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar phye/ bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur bas so// rten brten par bcas pa gsal bar gyur// 'jug pa'o// de nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po che// cis kyang mi tshugs mi shigs pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur stsal du gsol// slob ma las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i ku sha'i stan la bzhag oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ rang nyid dam slob ma rnams stong pa nyid du gyur// stong pa'i ngang las bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog bai ḍūr+ya mthon mthing lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po blta bas chog mi shes par mdzes pa/ cod pan la sogs pa lha'i rgyan dang na bza' thams cad kyis spras pa/ glang po che'i khri gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ge sar bsil zer can gyis mnan cing zla bas rgyab brten byas pa'i steng du rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ me tog phog pa'i lha 'am gtso bor bskyed/ dkyil 'khor gyi sngags bzlas pa'i gdugs ba dan rgyal mtshan rol mo dang*/

gnod mdzes kyi sngags bzlas pa'i bdug spos kyis bdug cing bum pa spyan drangs te/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum gzungs bzlas pas bskor ba byas nas slob ma'i spyi bor zhes pa ni slob ma sta gon gyi dbang du byas pa ste/ gzhan du/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā= 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma dag byed cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// gzungs dang*/ che ge zhes bya'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa ser sna'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig de bzhin du/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// khrims 'chal dri ma dag byed cing*// tshul khrims dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// na mo rat+na sogs gzungs dang*/ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa khrims 'chal gyi dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// khong khro'i dri ma dag byed cing*// bzod pa dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// na mo rat+na sogs gzungs dang*/ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa khong khro'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu// le lo'i dri ma dag byed cing*// brtson pa dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// na mo rat+na

sogs gzungs dang*/ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa le lo'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu// rnam g.yeng dri ma dag byed cing*// bsam gtan dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// na mo rat+na sogs gzungs dang*/ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa rnam g.yeng dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu// shes 'chal dri ma dag byed cing*// shes rab dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// na mo rat+na sogs gzungs dang*/ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa shes 'chal gyi dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig yid bzhin gyi nor bu rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i phyag rgya spyi bo dang dpral ba sogs su gtugs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca sogs brjod/ 'dis dbang bskur ba tsam gyis rig sngags thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro// rig sngags bsgrub pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad rim pa bzhin gtad la/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yis// ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te// rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i// bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig

/'gi'u wang dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman// sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas// nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal dag gyur cig /zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// snying po rnam dag ye shes mchog rtogs nas// yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur ba yi// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /dūr bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs nas// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel bar shog /bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun// byang chub snying po mchog tu dag gyur te// bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub par shog /dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te// chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te// chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus nas kyang*// chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa yi// mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi gyur cig/ 'byor pa thob pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas slar bum pas/ gzungs bzlas pa'i rjes su/ sarba pā paṃ shan+tiṃku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ sarba dz+wa ra= sarba u pa dra ye= sarba gra he= sarba a ka la mṛ tu= sarba dur sob nan= sarba du mṛ taṃ= sarba ku la bhai shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing lan mang du bkru'o// de nas shan+tiṃ ku ru'i tshab tu/ sarba pā paṃ a pa na ya swā hā/ zhes brjod/ rma bya'i sgros byabs pas sdig sgrib thams cad dug gi rgya mtshor dor bar bsam mo// de nas bsrung ba ni/

spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar rdo rje rgya gram bzhag la shan+tiṃ ku ru'i tshab tu sarba pā paṃ rak+ṣa zhes brjod nas/ bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa yi byin rlabs dang*// gsang sngags rig sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs dang*// bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis// 'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod par ma byed cig/ ces brjod la bsrung*/ bgegs zhi ba'i dbang ngo*// de nas slob ma pad+ma la bzhag steng du gdugs bkod/ mchod pas mchod cing rol mo dang bcas lag pa g.yas su rdo rje/ g.yon du 'khor lo bzhag nas/ ji ltar 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal// bdag po bya phyir dbang bskur ba// de bzhin chos rgyal dbang bskur phyir// rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur brjod// dam tshig sdom pa 'bogs pa ni// de ring phyin chad khyed rnams kyis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// byang chub sems sde rnams dang ni// gsang sngags rig sngags tshogs rnams la// dad pa rab tu brtan par bya// rtag par phyag rgya chen po la// khyad par du ni mos par bya// dam tshig can dang mdza' bo dang*// bla ma la yang gus par bya// lha rnams kun la sdang mi bya// dus tshod dag tu mchod pa bya// ston pa gzhan gyi gzhung mi mchod// rtag tu glo bur mgron mchod bya// srog chags rnams la byams pa'i sems// rab tu brtan pa nye bar bzhag /theg pa che la dga' rnams kyis// bsod nams dag la nan tan bskyed// bzlas pa byed la 'bad pa dang*// gsang sngags spyod la brtson par bya// gsang sngags rgyud las bstan pa yi// dam tshig rnams kyang bsrung bar bya// dam tshig med pa rnams la ni// sngags dang phyag rgya mi sbyin no// gsang sngags rgyud ni legs bsrung zhing*// de yang bdag gis rtogs par bya// zhes brjod// de dag khas blangs par mos la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid//

ces brjod par bya'o// slob dpon gyi go 'phang thob par byed pa'i dbang ngo*// sa gzhi spos chu'i byug shing me tog sogs maṇ+ḍal phul dge ba bsngo 'o/// / ༈ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i lho sgo'i cho ga bzhugs so// tha ma lho sgo'i cho ga la rten bskyed pa/ rnam shes dgug pa/ bgegs dang sdig pa sbyang ba/ skyabs su 'gror 'jug pa/ dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ zas gtad pa/ lam bstan pa/ ming byang sreg pa brgyad las/ dang po ni/ ro yod na khrus byas dri bzang byugs/ gtso bo'i sngags mgo dang*/ lha mo brgyad sgo ma'i sngags yan lag bzhi so sor btags/ med pa ni bris pa'i grib rten gos sogs la/ badz+ra yak+ṣa sbyangs oṃ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las nṛ las tshe 'das de sngar gson po'i gnas skabs kyi gzugs ji lta bar gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos= dge 'dun= las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rgyun gcod pa'i bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song ba che ge mo'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum rigs drug bar ma dor gar gnas kyang skad cig yud tsam cig la 'dir khug cig lan gsum/ tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod ni// byams gdung gnyen dang 'grogs pa'i skal med do// mi lus tshe 'phos 'jig rten snang ba nub// rnam shes sems ni mi rtag tshul ston te// las kyi dbang gis pha rol song ba khyod// nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rgyud lngar skyes pa 'am// skye gnas bzhi po ltung ba'i sar skyes te// gar skyes gang na gnas pa'i sa phyogs der// brtse gdung yid la gcags pa'i gnyen 'dun gyis// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song mthu rtsal te// sangs rgyas thugs rje che ba'i byin rlabs dang*// chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i nus mthu dang*// sngags 'chang rtse gcig bsgrub pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// las dang nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rgyud sbyangs shing*// gnyen pos gshed mar gyur pa'i bgegs dang dbye// rigs drug skye gnas gang na gnas gyur kyang*// re dogs med pa'i sems kyis 'dir shog cig/

hūm̐/ nga ni dpa' bo chen po ste// tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod kyi// khyod kyi slob dpon nga yin te// lha dang snying po dran gyis la// mtho ris lhag gnas bgrod bya'i phyir// rtsol ba'i sems stobs ma chung bar// gnas 'dir da lta nyid du shog /badz+ra satwa hūm̐ dzaḥtshe 'das kyi rnam shes a dmar por gyur te spyi bor zhugs snying kar song bas gson po ji lta bar gyur/ gsum pa ni/ sbyang chas bshams/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān namas+sarba tathāgate bh+yo bishwa mukhebh+yaḥ sarbathā khaṃ ud+gate s+pharan imaṃ gagan khaṃ grih+ṇa i daṃ ba ling+ta swā hā/ zhi bas sbyang ba'o// ting lo dang chang bu rdzas zhi ba/ sum+bha ni

zlos pa drag po ste/ zhi drag phyed ma'o// drag pos sbyang ba ni/ rang nyid khro bo me ltar 'bar bar yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje gnod sbyin/ m dang ṭ las mig gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras huṃ las rdo rje/ rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan par gyur pa langs la rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas stangs stabs byas/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag sham can// rig pa'i rgyal po khro rgyal bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// zhes khro bo'i tshogs spyan drangs pa la/ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rnam lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas khro bo'i skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la= lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug gsum rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa'i// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la= bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la= gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog

/khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la= hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// bka' bsgo ba/ hūm̐/ nga ni gnas 'dir gshin la dbang bskur byed// bgegs rnams 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// gal te nga yi bka' las 'das pa na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// de bas myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig /sum+bha ni zhes bgegs bskrad/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo drag tu brdungs pas bgegs rnams ring du bskrad par bsam mo// bgegs sbyang ba'o// tshe 'das kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas kyi sdig sgrib thams cad yi ge paṃ mam kaṃ nag po'i rnam par 'dug pa/ oṃ sarba bi sho dha na sarba pā paṃ ā na ya hūm̐/ zhes pa de nyid kyi sna sgo nas sdig pa ra tsa'i rnam par mdun gyi til la bkug mdun du khro bo hūm̐ mdzad zhal shin tu gdangs par mtheb mdzub kyis phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya hūm̐/ g.yas su me dang g.yon du chu bzhag nas bsreg blugs bya/ rol mo dang bcas pas phyir dor/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a pa na ya sho dha na hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes pas sdig pa thams cad sbyangs par bsam/ de nas yungs kar dang bye nag la gzungs sngags bzla zhing de la brab/ rgyas par 'dod na durga yang bya'o// de nas las bum gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la khrus gsol zhing*/ des slar tshe 'das bkrus pa'i mos pa bya zhing*/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyes pa mi mnga' yang*// tshe 'das lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// tshe 'das lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐// rgyal ba'i gsung la 'gag pa mi mnga' yang*// tshe 'das ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i gsung la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// tshe 'das ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur cig

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs la 'khrul pa mi mnga' yang*// tshe 'das yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// tshe 'das yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// zhes dang*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri chab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// khrus so// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// dam pa'i chos la dug mi mnga'// dam chos gzi yis dug bcom mo/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dug mi mnga'// dge 'dun gzi yis dug bcom mo// sa ni dug gi pha yin te// sa ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// tshe 'das dug ni dug med shog /chu ni dug gi pha yin te// chu ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// tshe 'das dug ni dug med shog /me ni dug gi pha yin te// me ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// tshe 'das dug ni dug med shog /rlung ni dug gi pha yin te// rlung ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// tshe 'das dug ni dug med shog/ rgyas par spro na/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam 'joms dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog

/'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang zhig bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin tu rtag bskyangs des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' ba// gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur zhing*// don 'grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba des// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang 'byung des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kyi ni bsam pa yis// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub par shog

/rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shog /khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur// khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig/ sogs kyang brjod/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu// dang por skyes kyang las las skyes// tha ma 'chi yang las kyis 'chi// skye 'chi 'du 'bral dus bab na// sdug cing brtse ba'i nye drung dang*// skad cig 'grogs pa'i dbang med do// lus ni sgyu ma'i phung po zhig /sems ni dge sdig las dang 'grogs// lus ni sems kyi rten yin te// sems ni mtshan ma'i ming la chags// gzhan yang 'dod na rgyas par bshad/ bsdus na bar do gsol 'debs thar pa'i lcags kyu rgyal dbang rjes mdzad pa/ na mo ma hā mu dra ya/ chos kun sgyu ma lta bur thugs chud pas// ma dag sgyu ma las grol dag pa yi// sku brnyes sgyu ma'i 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'i// 'dren mdzad sgyu ma'i sku la skyabs su mchi// sgyu ma'i lus can mgon po khyod kyis ni// sgyu mas bslus pa'i bdag sogs sems can rnams// sgyu ma'i snang bas bslu bar mi 'gyur zhing*// sgyu ma rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs// mi rtag sgyu ma'i lus 'di bor ba'i tshe// chags sdang zhen pa'i 'khri ba kun bcad nas// sems nyid ma bcos rang sor bzhag pa yis// 'chi ba lam du longs par= 'chi tshe phyi yi snang ba 'gags pa na// mig sogs dbang po lnga ni rim pas 'gags// gzugs sogs yul lnga gcig la gcig thim dus// thim rim rang ngo shes par= sa chu me rlung rnam shes la thim pas// lus kyi zungs shor skom zhing kha sna skams// drod yal thung lang rtsub pa'i dbugs bsnyod tshe// gnad gcod lam du longs par= rnam shes 'od gsal la thim phyi dbugs chad// nang dbugs gnas pa'i skad cig bzhi la ni// snang mched thob pa 'od gsal chen po bzhi// rim par rang ngo shes par=

snang ba'i nang rtags du ba phyi rtags ni// zla ba shar 'dra zhe sdang las gyur pa'i// rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum 'gags pa'i tshe// gsal dang dran 'dun thongs par= mched pa'i nang rtags me khyer phyi yi rtags// nyi ma shar 'dra 'dod chags las gyur pa'i// rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gags par gyur pa na// shes bzhin dran pas zin par= thob pa'i nang rtags mar me 'bar 'dra la// phyi rtags nag lam sgra gcan lta bu ste// gti mug las gyur rtog pa bdun 'gags tshe// yang dag dran pas zin par= bzhi pa 'od gsal chen por shar ba'i tshe// nang rtags sprin bral nam mkha' lta bu la// phyi rtags skya rengs shar ba lta bu'i dus// 'od gsal ma bu 'dres par= de la mi gnas rnam shes 'pho ba na// lte ba smin mtshams tshogs ma sna rna ba// mig dang bshang lam chu lam kha dang dgu// bkag nas sgo gcig dbye bar= 'dod gzugs gzugs med gnod sbyin mi 'am ci// mi dang dud 'gro dmyal ba yi dwags su// skye ba'i skye sgo bkag nas mkha' spyod du// dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bsu bar= gal te rnam shes bar dor 'khyams pa na// rang nyid shi bar ma shes gnyen grogs dang*// 'grogs par sems kyang lan med yi chad tshe// chags sdang 'khri ba chod par= dbang po kun tshang las dbang rdzu 'phrul ldan// ri rab rdo rje gdan dang ma yi mngal// ma gtogs kun la thogs med bgrod pa'i tshe// thams cad sgyu mar shes par= nyi zla mi snang lus la grib ma med// bsam pa tsam gyis stong gsum bskor bar nus// dbang med bya sgro rlung khyer lta bu'i dus// rang sems rang dbang thob par= zas su dri za yad yud phya ma phyo// 'khrul pa'i snang ba du mar shar ba yis// 'jigs shing skyo bas snying rlung langs pa'i tshe// 'khrul snang rang ngo shes par= res 'ga' dran pa shin tu gsal gyur kyang*// de ma thag tu brjed par gyur nas ni// shi gson the tshom skyes par gyur pa'i tshe// nges par shi bar shes par=

phyed dang bzhi yi phyi ma phan chad nas// rang nyid shi ba yin pa ngo shes shing*// yi mug ga chad skyabs gnas 'tshol ba'i tshe// rang rig skyabs su shes par= bar dor bar do yin par shes pa'i tshe// rang lus lha sgom de las 'od gsal sgom// slar yang zung 'jug nyid du bsgom pa yi// dag pa'i sgyu lus 'char bar= ri nyil rgya mtsho 'chos dang nags tshal bsregs// dus mtha'i rlung chen langs pa lta bu'i sgra// 'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba la 'jigs tshe// chos nyid rang sgrar shes par= kha dog lnga ldan 'od zer 'khrug cing 'bar// 'od dang thig le thig phran lta bu las// 'jigs pa'i khro tshogs rgyob gsod sgra sgrogs tshe// rang snang lha ru shes par= 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug las gyur pa'i// dkar dang dmar dang nag po'i gcong g.yang la// rang nyid lhung snyam rab tu 'jigs pa'i tshe// rang snang dag tu shes par= gang du skye ba'i lus kyi gzugs grub cing*// dkar dmar ser dang sngo ba nag po'i 'od// lha mi dud 'gro yi dwags dmyal ba yi// lam lnga rim bzhin shes par= gzhal med khang du lha bu 'dod spyod dang*// ngang pa khyu mchog rta yis brgyan pa'i mtsho// khang bzang pha ma'i 'du 'phrod mthong gyur na// chags sdang mig ser dag par= rlung dmar char sprin tsha grang gis bdas pas// phug pa grog po sdong dum la sogs rtsar// skyabs phyir 'jug pa'i snang ba byung gyur na// skye gnas ngan par shes par= srog gcod me dang lcags kyi khang bzang mthong*// dga' ba'i yid kyis gnas der 'jug sems na// rang ngo shes shing brjed pa med pa yi// gnas ngan de las bzlog par= mngal dang sgong skyes mig ser phrag dog dang*// drod gsher las skyes dri dang ro la chags// rdzus skyes gnas la chags pa skyes pa'i tshe// chags sdang sred pa med par= pha ma la sogs skye gnas mthong ba'i tshe// chags sdang med cing sgyu mar shes pa dang*// gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'i dran pa yis// zhen med mngal sgo kheg par=

gal te ma kheg skye ba len pa na// bde ba can dang dga' ldan mngon dga'am// 'khor los sgyur rgyal bram ze'i rigs tu// bsams shing skye ba len par= skyes ma thag tu sngon gyi gnas dran zhing*// theg chen chos la spyod pa'i skal bar ldan// brtse bas gzhan don 'ba' zhig sems byed cing*// brtson pas byang chub myur du 'grub par shog /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang*// chos nyid rang bzhin rnam par dag pa dang*// bdag kyang bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i mthus// ji ltar smon pa de bzhin 'grub par shog/ bzhi pa ni// dngos su nye du zhig rjes zlos byed du bcug ste des byas par mos la/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la// de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi// bdag ni 'jigs pas rnam skrag ste// kun tu bzang la bdag nyid 'bul// 'jam dpal dbyangs la bdag nyid kyis// bdag gi lus 'di 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan bdag la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje che mgon thams cad la// skyabs 'tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byer mdzad pa'i// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol//

zhes brjod/ sku tshe bstan pa bskal chen 'bum phrag bcu// zhing gi khyon dang nyan thos byang sems kyi// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' mi mngon pa'i// 'dren pa mnyam med thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// skye bo nyon mongs dug gis mgo rmongs nas// 'gro drug bar ma do ru 'khyams pa rnams// de ring nyid du phan mdzad phyag rkyong la// mngon dga'i zhing du drongs shig mi 'khrugs pa// zhes brjod/ lnga pa ni/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa nas rig sngags bsgrub pa dang bgegs zhi ba'i dbang gnyis bskur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis slob ma khrus byas/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs maṇ+ḍal phul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcings/ bdun rnam dag gis skyabs sems phog bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa kye// gtso 'khor thams cad dgongs su gsol// mi shes mun gyis bsgribs pa la// dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ bla mas khrid shar sgo nas zhugs khyams su gnas pa la/ lam chen 'di ni bstan par bya// khyod kyis lam 'di sgrub bar gyis// lam mchog bsgrub la rab tu dga'// nyes pa dag gis ma gos na// 'bras bu myur du 'byin par byed// dam tshig 'das na dmyal bar ltung*// oṃ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥn ra kan hūm̐ zhes mna' chu sbyin/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag nas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya sogs kyi gzungs lan gsum bzlas/ rol mo'i sgra dang sngags kyis btab pa'i yungs kar dang gu gul gyi dud pas bdug des lha'i rigs kyi bsod nams ci 'dra ba de bzhin du 'bab par 'gyur ro// des dkyil 'khor dbang du 'gyur la/ de nas/ rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma'i steng du 'dug la me tog gi 'phreng ba/ hūm̐ pū dza hoḥ zhes pas dkyil 'khor du dor bar bya'o// gtso bo la rdo rje rigs sogs par brda sprad/

gang la phog pa des slar dngos grub kyi don du mgo bor bcings/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar phye/ bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur bas so// rten brten par bcas pa gsal bar gyur// 'jug pa'o// de nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po che// cis kyang mi tshugs mi shigs pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur stsal du gsol// slob ma las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i ku sha'i stan la bzhag me tog phog pa'i lha 'am gtso bor bskyed/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ tshe 'das mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur// stong pa'i ngang las ku sha khri yi gdan la tshe 'das skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog bai ḍūr+ya mthon mthing lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po blta bas chog mi shes par mdzes pa/ cod pan la sogs pa lha'i rgyan dang na bza' thams cad kyis spras pa/ glang po che'i khri gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ge sar bsil zer can gyis mnan cing zla bas rgyab brten byas pa'i steng du rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ na mo rat+na tra sogs sngags rol mo dang bcas lan gsum/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma dag byed cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// gzungs dang*/ che ge zhes bya'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa ser sna'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig de bzhin du/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// khrims 'chal dri ma dag byed cing*// tshul khrims dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// na mo rat+na

sogs gzungs dang*/ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa khrims 'chal gyi dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// khong khro'i dri ma dag byed cing*// bzod pa dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// na mo rat+na sogs gzungs dang*/ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa khong khro'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu// le lo'i dri ma dag byed cing*// brtson pa dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// na mo rat+na sogs gzungs dang*/ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa le lo'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu// rnam g.yeng dri ma dag byed cing*// bsam gtan dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// na mo rat+na sogs gzungs dang*/ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa rnam g.yeng gi dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu// shes 'chal dri ma dag byed cing*// shes rab dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// na mo rat+na

sogs gzungs dang*/ tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa shes 'chal gyi dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig yid bzhin gyi nor bu rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i phyag rgya spyi bo dang dpral ba sogs su gtugs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca sogs brjod/ 'dis dbang bskur ba tsam gyis rig sngags thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro// de nas slar bum pas/ gzungs bzlas pa'i rjes su/ sarba pā paṃ shan+tiṃku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ sarba dz+wa ra= sarba u pa dra ye= sarba gra he= sarba a ka la mṛ tu= sarba dur sob nan= sarba du mṛ taṃ= sarba ku la bhai shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing lan mang du bkru'o// de nas shan+tiṃ ku ru'i tshab tu/ sarba pā paṃ a pa na ya swā hā/ sarba dz+wa ra= sarba u pa dra ye= sarba gra he= sarba a ka la mṛ tu= sarba dur sob nan= sarba du mṛ taṃ= sarba ku la bhai shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ rma bya'i sgros byabs pas sdig sgrib thams cad dug gi rgya mtshor dor bar bsam mo// de nas bsrung ba ni/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar rdo rje rgya gram bzhag la shan+tiṃ ku ru'i tshab tu sarba pā paṃ rak+ṣa swā hā/ sarba dz+wa ra= sarba u pa dra ye= sarba gra he= sarba a ka la mṛ tu= sarba dur sob nan= sarba du mṛ taṃ= sarba ku la bhai shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sa gzhi spos chu'i byug shing me tog sogs maṇ+ḍal phul/ drug pa ni de nas me tog phog pa'i lhar skad cig gis bskyed/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ tshe 'das mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur// stong pa'i ngang las ku sha khri yi gdan la tshe 'das skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog bai ḍūr+ya mthon mthing lta bu/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po blta bas chog mi shes par mdzes pa/ cod pan la sogs pa lha'i rgyan dang na bza' thams cad kyis spras pa/ glang po che'i khri gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ge sar bsil zer can gyis mnan cing zla bas rgyab brten byas pa'i steng du rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ badz+ra yak+ṣa sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ yo byad rnams mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yo byad rnams gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ phud gnyis bcad/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa ka ma gu ṇa pū dza hoḥ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shap+ta ka ma gu ṇa pūdza hoḥ phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sbrul snying bcas// a kar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhe ka ma gu ṇa pū dza hoḥ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ta rā s+ye ka ma gu ṇa pūdza hoḥ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta par+she ka ma gu ṇa pū dza hoḥ

zhes pas phul/ de nas tshe 'das la bsngo ba/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu// gur khang 'di ni skyabs kyi mkhar// dar zab 'di ni grang ba'i skyabs// gdugs chung 'di ni tshad pa'i bsil// srog shing 'di ni sku yi rten// mtshan byang 'di ni gsung gi rten// me long 'di ni sems kyi rten// rnam shes rten du 'phan dar brgyad// dri ma 'di ni gos kyi rten// nye drung 'di ni sngar gyi bshes// mar me 'di ni gsal ba'i 'od// pad+ma 'di ni sdod pa'i stan// bza' bca' bldag gzhib zas kyi don// 'dzad pa med par longs spyod cig/ bdun pa ni/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu// khyod sems dug lnga'i dbang song bas// dug lnga'i las kyis khyod re bslus// dug lnga'i las kyis khyod re bkol// dug lnga spongs shig rigs kyi bu// dug lnga'i las kyi rnam smin gyis// 'khor ba'i gnas su skye ba yin// 'khor ba'i gnas ni nyon re mongs// nyon mongs 'khor ba'i gnas shed na// khyod kyi pha ma nga yin zer// khyod kyi nye du nga yin zer/ khyod kyi gnyen bshes nga yin zer/ khyod kyi zla grogs nga yin zer// 'o dod lhang lhang 'bod pa 'ong*// de la skad lan ma byin cig /de la phyi mig ma blta zhig /gnyen bshes nor la ma chags par// mi bskyod 'khor dang bcas pa la// dad pa'i sems kyis phyag 'tshol las// mgon po rnams la skyabs gsol zhig /rigs drug la ma chags par gdams pa'o// 'di nas shar gyi phyogs rol na// mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa// byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas// srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las grol// zhing gi yon tan bsam mi khyab// su zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin cing*// dmigs pa med pa'i sems kyis su// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// zhing mchog de ru skye bar gsungs// tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod kyang*// mi 'khrugs pa yi mtshan gzung zhing*// byang chub sems kyi sems bskyed kyis// zhing mchog de ru 'gro bar gyis//

lam sbyang ba'o// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba'i// dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyi// rin chen 'phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam// rnam par dag pa'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te// 'phags pa'i lam der bgrod par shog/ ces lam bstan pas/ 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs mkha' spyod bsun ma pad+ma dkar pos/ mi khyod rang gi lus dbus rtsa dbu ma// 'od phung gi rnam pa'i stong ra'i nang*// sems skye med hūm̐ gi rnam par ltos// spyi bor rje btsun bla ma bsgom// tshe 'di la chags zhing zhen pa bskyur// dpal 'og min gnas su smon lam thob// pha dkar brgyud kun gyi ngo bo nyid// skyabs sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dngos// lha yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun// don gcig bsdus bla ma rin po che// blo rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs// rje thugs rje'i lcag kyus gzung mdzod la// da khams gsum 'khor bar mi 'khyams par// dpal mngon dga'i 'og min gnas su bla ma rje'i// 'khor dag pa'i khrod du skyel bar mdzod// ngag de skad brjod cing yid la bsgom/ mchog dge ba'i bshes kyi hūm̐ brjod pas// sems hūm̐ gi rnam pa yar yar song*// pha bla ma'i thugs kar thim pa'i mthar// de 'og min nam mngon dga' zhing du song bar 'gyur// tshe 'das kyi rnam shes lha'i rnam pa de spyi gtsug nas 'thon te shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su gshegs pas/ der pad+ma la brdzus te skyes nas/ de na gnas pa'i byang sems rnying pa rnams kyis mchod/ sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i zhal mthong*/ mchod nas gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa thob par bsam/ des kyang der skye ba'i rgyu brtags pas cho ga mkhan pos cho ga byas pa'i nus mthur shes nas skad cig gis 'ongs te/

e ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni// sngags kyi byin rlabs ya mtshan che// gang phyir mtshams med ltung ba yi// sems can lha gnas myur du skyes// zhes ched du brjod nas bdag dang lha la mchod pas mchod de phyag btsal nas slar mngon dgar song bar bsam mo// brgyad pa ni/ rnam shes gshegs pa'i ming byang phung po'i rnam par bsams de nyid sdig sgrib dang lhan cig tu ye shes kyi mes bsregs par bsam zhing*/ phung po lnga yi bud shing la// sangs rgyas lnga yi me sbar ro// 'byung ba lnga yi bud shing*// ye shes lnga yi me sbar ro// dbang po drug gi bud shing la// sems dpa' drug gi me sbar ro// yul rnams drug gi bud shing la// lha mo drug gi me sbar ro// rnam shes brgyad kyi bud shing la// sems dpa' brgyad kyi me sbar ro// skye mched bcu gnyis bud shing la// byang chub sems dpa'i me sbar ro// lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la// sku gsung thugs kyi me sbar ro// sna tshogs snang ba'i dngos po la// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes me// nyon mongs lnga yi bud shing la// khro bo lnga yi me sbar ro// yan lag bcu gnyis bud shing la// khro bo bcu yi me sbar ro// ma dag phung po la sogs pa// mtshan ma'i bud shing ma lus pa// dag pa rgyal ba la sogs pa// ye shes me yis ma lus sreg /da ni dag dang ma dag pa// bdag gzhan bde sdug skye 'gag dang*// rtag chad gcig dang du ma sogs// gnyis su 'dzin pa spangs nas su// gnyis med gnyis su med par ston// yang dag mtha' la rnam par gnas// bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan// tshe 'das de yis thob par shog/
